description: This PHP source file defines the OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet class, a dashboard widget for visualizing opportunities grouped by lead source in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering a chart, fetching data, and configuring display options.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard dashlet class for displaying opportunities by lead source as a chart.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Configures search options for lead sources and user IDs.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML/JavaScript code for rendering the chart visualization.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the constructed SQL query and processes the result set into a dataset.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares chart labels, data, and keys from raw dataset, including total calculations.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query string to fetch opportunity data grouped by lead source.
